cues: Start with the simplest movement of all.
Drop a little dye into still water.
Its particles jiggle with their own heat energy, and on average they spread from where they are crowded to where they are scarce.
text: Start with the simplest movement of all. Drop a little dye into still water. Its particles jiggle with their own heat energy, and on average they spread from where they are crowded to where they are scarce. That is diffusion.
